purpose: Take over and test the owned, non-injecting DX12 dual-GPU compute prototype on the current laptop. This is not a measurement of third-party game FPS.

hardware_expected.primary: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2070 with Max-Q Design
hardware_expected.display: 1920x1080 internal display attached to Intel; the compute experiment does not present to it

background_policy: Do not close GameViewer, Codex, Pavise or other user processes. Log observed GPU activity; inactivity of mouse and keyboard does not imply an uncontaminated machine.

pre_measurement_amendment.reason: First CPU/input idle attempt did not start the GPU benchmark: 55 available CPU samples ranged 22.42-41.26%, mean 29.528%. Remote access remained connected; minimizing its main UI did not remove background load.
pre_measurement_amendment.exploratory_environment: Explicit background_loaded_screening allows three preflight CPU samples <=50%; no idle-machine claim. Correctness-only preflight omits the irrelevant CPU idle requirement.
pre_measurement_amendment.unchanged: All pixel, timing, drift, gain, AC, input, timeout and NVIDIA temperature gates remain unchanged. The fixed four-case matrix remains unchanged.
pre_measurement_amendment.confirmation: A positive loaded screening result still requires an independently repeated quiet-environment experiment; do not silently stop remote access or lower the shipping standard.

preflight: Attested source/executable SHA256 and successful build manifest
Pure statistic self-tests, adapter enumeration and capability probe
Correctness validation for both direct and copy paths before timing
AC connected, no recent input, three CPU samples <=20%, NVIDIA temperature below 83 C
Every measured invocation also validates its exact size/loop configuration with fixed seeds

independent_confirmation.only_if: A correctness-valid exploratory case passes all CANDIDATE gates without environmental guard violations
independent_confirmation.parameters: Keep the passing case's resolution, workload and transfer path unchanged
independent_confirmation.must_not: Search many workloads or discard unfavorable runs and report only the largest gain

safety.temperature_limitations: CPU and Intel GPU temperatures are not observed. NVIDIA limit alone is not a whole-laptop thermal guarantee.

delivery_gate: A compute-only candidate is not product-ready. Shipping requires a concrete Pavise-owned external workload, equal output endpoint and quality, capture/copy/present costs and latency, repeated net benefit and safe fallback. No game DLL injection and no claim to relocate an unmodified game's internal passes.
invalid_run_policy: Preserve every result, state the cause, and correct measurement defects before a separately labeled rerun. Do not treat INVALID as proof of either benefit or loss. Safety or correctness failures stop further GPU tests until investigated.
